scope: P003 original panel only; exploration traces not scanned.
method: Only one-tool-call steps with dict observation after one JSON decode are attributed. Production-file prefix is a path proxy. Successful edit_file/write_file is status=ok, independent of final diff; run_command can edit files and is not captured by this particular counter. Dict observations with only an error field are counted separately under InvocationErrorField_derived. No attempt is reclassified automatically. Read and edit escaping flags alone do not prove harness fault. Identical consecutive tool calls are a new exact-signature measure, not the CSV no-progress heuristic; repeating a valid call need not imply no progress.

completion_analysis.limitation: The trace has no independent compaction-call identifier. Distribution covers recorded agent steps only and does not establish coverage of any unrecorded compaction/inference calls or the failed overflowing call. Zero observed calls >=8192 supports a lower-cap diagnostic, not a guarantee against future truncation or changed trajectories. Quantiles use linear interpolation at (n-1)*p. No model thought text is exported.
